entity_name: Народна банка на Република Северна Македонија
source_name: НБРСМ — Стратегиски план на Народната банка (multi-year strategic plan)
why_relevant: Rolling 3-year strategic plans (2019-2021, 2020-2022, 2022-2024, and per press coverage a 2025-2027 plan) set the medium-term regulatory agenda that the annual Work Programme operationalises. Gives 2-3 year lead time on themes (EU acquis alignment, payments, resolution, digitalisation) before any draft decision appears.

entity_name: Народна банка на Република Северна Македонија
source_name: Одлука за издавање дозволи и согласности на платежна институција и институција за електронски пари и за содржината и начинот на водење на регистрите
why_relevant: The NBRNM decision that legally constitutes the PI/EMI registers and prescribes their content and upkeep — the schema definition for the two most important registers in this cell.

entity_name: Народна банка на Република Северна Македонија
source_name: Закон за платежни услуги и платни системи (consolidated, NBRNM PDF)
why_relevant: Consolidated PSD2-aligned law (latest amendments per OG 144/25) creating the PI/EMI/PSO registers and defining the licensed categories the registers enumerate; anchor text for the whole cell.

entity_name: Народна банка на Република Северна Македонија
source_name: НБРСМ — Одлука за издавање дозволи (consolidated PDF)
why_relevant: Shows the site's /content/Regulativa/ PDF store pattern — consolidated ('пречистен текст') act texts are directly downloadable, which is the highest-fidelity artefact for compliance-deadline extraction.

entity_name: Народна банка на Република Северна Македонија
source_name: НБРСМ — Рамка за обелоденување и методологија за проценка на ПИФП (oversight assessment framework, PDF)
why_relevant: PFMI-based disclosure and assessment methodology the central bank applies to KIBS/CaSys/MIPS. Drives the operators' own disclosure frameworks and remediation obligations, which in turn become participant-facing rule changes.

entity_name: Народна банка на Република Северна Македонија
source_name: НБРСМ — Стратегија за развој на платниот систем (payment system development strategy)
why_relevant: Strategy document from the National Payment System Council setting the medium-term infrastructure agenda (instant payments, standards, interoperability) from which operator-level deadlines are derived.

source_name: ЕНЕР — draft-regulation detail pages for FX / financial-sector laws (worked examples)
why_relevant: Concrete evidence that financial-sector drafts really are consulted on ENER: a draft Law amending the Law on Foreign Exchange Operations (Закон за девизното работење), explicitly framed as harmonisation with the Law on Payment Services and Payment Systems. Shows the exact document set (draft text + RIA report + consultation window) our collector should expect.

source_name: MDT portal – compendium 'Закони кои го регулираат финансискиот систем'
why_relevant: A government-published compendium enumerating the statutes governing the MK financial system — an instant, authoritative checklist of every law an A3 run must track (banking, payment services, AML, insurance, securities), with the exact official titles needed for gazette and ENER keyword matching.

source_name: Ministry of Digital Transformation portal — Macedonian translations of EC Country Reports
why_relevant: Official Macedonian-language versions of the EC country reports; useful for extracting the exact local terminology used for EU financial-services concepts (glossary building) and for tracking how the government renders EU requirements domestically.

source_name: Ministry of Finance – 'Отворени финансии' open finance portal & news
why_relevant: The Ministry of Finance is co-legislator for financial-sector statutes and publishes dataset updates through the Open Finance portal; its news feed is the earliest official signal that a financial law is going to consultation and that data releases have been refreshed.

source_name: ФУЛМ Штедилница — republication of MBA announcements
why_relevant: Member institutions republish MBA соопштенија verbatim. Member sites act as a mirror when the association's own posting is delayed or removed, and reveal which announcements members choose to amplify.

source_name: ОПМ — Прирачник за финансиски услуги (consumer financial-services manual, 2025)
why_relevant: Recent NGO manual on consumer rights in financial services; useful as a glossary of the local complaint vocabulary and as evidence of which practices consumer advocates currently target.

source_name: Закон за заштита на потрошувачите при договори за потрошувачки кредити (statute text, ОПМ-hosted copy)
why_relevant: Text of the consumer-credit statute that court and complaint decisions cite by article. Needed to map a judgment's cited provision to substance. Note: this is a third-party copy and may be superseded — the consolidated official text should be pulled from Службен весник / NBRM.

source_name: European Commission — Enlargement/DG FISMA SEPA accession announcements
why_relevant: Official EU-side confirmation of MK banks entering SEPA schemes and the phased dates; useful for dating migration milestones that MK operators then implement.

source_name: EC Screening report — North Macedonia, Cluster 3 (Competitiveness and Inclusive Growth, incl. Ch.9 Financial services)
why_relevant: The screening report is the most granular EU-side statement of MK's acquis gaps per chapter: it records MK's own presentation, the Commission's assessment and the level of preparedness, effectively a to-do list of directives/regulations still to be transposed (CRR/CRD, Solvency II, PSD2, DGS, MiFID II, etc.).

source_name: World Bank project procurement — P176366 'Building Effective, Transparent and Accountable PFM Institutions' (North Macedonia) procurement plans & STEP notices
why_relevant: The Ministry of Finance-implemented PFM project explicitly covers Macro-Economy & Public Finance and ICT/Telecommunications; its published procurement plan enumerates forthcoming goods/consultancy packages (treasury, tax, PFM IT) with methods, estimated values and dates — an early-warning list of upcoming state financial-systems tenders. National-market packages are cross-published on ESJN and the MoF site.

source_name: World Bank corporate procurement — Western Balkans / North Macedonia payments RFx notices
why_relevant: Reveals-indirectly: procurement notices for advisory work (electronic payments in MK, digital financial services legal diagnostics in the Western Balkans) disclose upcoming reform workstreams months before reports appear.

source_name: World Bank — Western Balkans SEPA/payments analytical features
why_relevant: IFI commentary that quantifies the practical effect of MK's PSD2/SEPA alignment and often reveals remaining implementation gaps (pricing, PSP licensing, instant payments) not stated in official EU texts.

source_name: European Banking Authority — North Macedonia equivalence assessment & opinions
why_relevant: EBA's equivalence annex for North Macedonia is a directive-by-directive comparison of MK banking supervision against CRR/CRD, i.e. an EU-authored gap analysis of MK prudential regulation; the underlying Commission equivalence decision has direct legal effect for EU banks' exposures to MK.

source_name: EBA Memorandum of Cooperation with South-Eastern European supervisors (Vienna Initiative)
why_relevant: Sets out the commitment of the MK national bank to align regulatory/supervisory standards with EU ones on an agreed timetable — a durable structural driver of MK rulemaking and a pointer to the Vienna Initiative workstream.

source_name: EBA — Opinion on CRR third-country equivalence for North Macedonia
why_relevant: EU-side technical assessment of whether MK supervisory and regulatory arrangements are equivalent to the CRR — a rare external benchmark of MK supervision quality with direct consequences for EU banks' MK exposures.

source_name: Meta.mk / Bankarstvo.mk — Macedonian coverage of NBRM regulatory acts
why_relevant: Local media restate NBRM adoptions in plain language with dates ('12 подзаконски акти', application from 1 Jan 2023) and surface regulator statements (e.g. NBRM calling for debate on bank fees) that hint at future rule-making. Useful as a change-detection tripwire and for context, never as the legal source.

source_name: Insurance Supervision Agency (АСО) — Fintech strategy for financial regulators 2023-2027
why_relevant: Joint strategy of the MK financial regulators (NBRM, ASO, SEC, MoF) setting the fintech/regulatory agenda that is explicitly benchmarked against EU acts; identifies planned regulatory interventions and cross-regulator coordination bodies. NOTE: URL captured from search results and may contain a transcription error — resolve from aso.mk before relying on it.

source_name: Државен завод за ревизија — NBRM regularity audit (worked example)
why_relevant: Confirms the State Audit Office does audit the central bank itself and publishes the report — establishes a recurring, enumerable series to track for findings about supervisory function and spending.

source_name: Council of Europe — analysis of inconsistent case law as a source of legal uncertainty (MK)
why_relevant: Documents the structural problem of inconsistent Macedonian case law — an important caveat for anyone treating a single judgment as settled law on bank fees, and a pointer to how harmonisation (начелни ставови) happens.

source_name: European Payments Council — North Macedonia SEPA scheme participation (news & insights)
why_relevant: EPC is the gatekeeper for SEPA scheme geographical scope; its decisions, criteria and legal-opinion requirements define the concrete compliance bar (PSD2/PAD/IFR/SEPA Regulation transposition) MK PSPs must meet, plus the register of which MK institutions have actually joined SCT/SCT Inst.

source_name: Karanović & Partners / Lexology — North Macedonia payment services legislation commentary
why_relevant: English-language law-firm commentary that flags changes in the Law on Payment Services and Payment Systems — including fee transparency and comparability duties that later generate complaints and disputes. Useful bridge for non-mk readers and an early-warning channel on enforcement-relevant rule changes.

source_name: Македонска берза / Централен депозитар за хартии од вредност — rules for membership & settlement
why_relevant: Adjacent infrastructure rule-setter: the exchange/CSD membership and settlement rules interoperate with MIPS for cash legs and are covered by the same NBRM oversight scheme map; relevant when tracking DvP settlement deadlines.

entity_name: MK business press cluster for event/award/hiring signals
source_name: MicroBalkans (Skopje) — regional non-bank finance conference
why_relevant: Third edition brings 200+ financial-sector representatives from 15 European countries to Skopje, explicitly including non-bank financial institutions, microcredit institutions, savings houses, fintechs and REGULATORS. Panel titles reveal the regulatory agenda facing MK non-bank PSPs/lenders; the delegate mix is an actor map for the sector.

source_name: ProCredit Bank MK blog — 'КИБС или МИПС плаќање, која е разликата'
why_relevant: Bank-authored explainer that states the operative thresholds and cut-offs distinguishing KIBS clearing from MIPS RTGS — a fast, plain-language cross-check on how scheme rules apply in practice.

source_name: US Commercial Service Country Commercial Guide — North Macedonia: Selling to the Public Sector / Trade Financing
why_relevant: Concise, regularly updated English orientation to the MK public procurement market (~€1bn/yr, EPPS centralisation, which IFIs fund what). Useful as a stable context/pointer document for onboarding new analysts and for confirming which donor channels matter — not a tender feed.

source_name: ClearingPost — MIPS North Macedonia infrastructure profile
why_relevant: Specialist trade analysis consolidating MIPS participant counts, SEPA accession and the TIPS Clone timeline — a useful cross-check and pointer to primary documents, though secondary and to be verified.

source_name: DevelopmentAid organisation profile — Asseco Macedonia
why_relevant: Aggregator profile confirming Asseco's registered MK entity and its donor-project footprint; useful for linking a global vendor brand to its local legal entity, which is the name that appears in MK registries and contracts.

source_name: Mondaq — North Macedonia FinTech Comparative Guide
why_relevant: Structured Q&A comparative guide on MK fintech/payments regulation (NBRNM authorisation of third-party payment providers, cybersecurity powers) — good baseline reference for regulatory perimeter questions.

source_name: Multilaw Business Guides — North Macedonia: Payment services
why_relevant: Law-firm-network comparative business guide with a dedicated MK payment-services section; low-cost English cross-check on licensing categories and perimeter.

source_name: RUSI — MONEYVAL mutual evaluation report summaries (incl. North Macedonia)
why_relevant: Condensed, comparable English summaries of the MONEYVAL findings — cheap triage layer before reading the full evaluation.

source_name: SEINet mobile application (iOS / Android) — push alerts on listed-issuer disclosures
why_relevant: Official MSE app allowing per-company subscription with immediate notification on publication. Establishes that a near-real-time push channel exists for bank filings; relevant for latency-sensitive monitoring design even if collection stays web-based.

source_name: Народен правобранител (Ombudsman) — Годишни извештаи
why_relevant: Annual reports to Parliament document citizen grievances across sectors, including complaints touching financial services, account blocking, enforcement (извршување) and administrative failures by state bodies. Dated, quantified, and tabled in Parliament, so they carry policy weight.

entity_name: Правилник за водење на регистарот на даватели на услуги брз трансфер на пари
source_name: Правилник за водење на регистарот на даватели на услуги брз трансфер на пари (dejure.mk consolidated)
why_relevant: The rulebook that defines what the fast-money-transfer provider register must contain and how it is kept — tells the collector exactly which fields to expect and when entries must be updated.
